original_local_details: R3-LOCAL-BERTH-DUTY is a new bounded functional public landing watch, not a recruited core character or mining operator.
The handoff binds the actual single GLIMMER instance, actual Q204 public and protected source handover, and its MC-2 next inquiry commission at the physical HUB-S02 chart.

Authority permits only the learner package's public R3-S01 berth and reciprocal freight landing path. Mining entry, local rescue, archive permission and Oren's consent require their own actual actions.

No tide, distance, weather or invented nautical measurement is introduced. Exact registered source and destination collision geometry, source receipts, three registered cabins and current gate versions remain mandatory.

Route registration, actual Travel relocation and actual public landing evidence are separate committed commands. They grant no unvisited material, reward, sample, current mentor status or task resolution.
